reasoning: The icon consists solely of the three letters 'ODT' inside a rectangle (a file-extension badge for OpenDocument Text). Per guidelines, icons that are only letters or digits and represent a technical file property rather than a glanceable pictorial object cannot serve as a good visual reminder at small sizes and should be discarded.
